title: Paper-Trader - Free Paper Trading Simulator with AI Coach | Paper-Trader.org
excerpt: Practice stocks, crypto, forex, indices, and commodities trading with real historical market data. AI-powered coaching included. No signup required.
content_html:
Paper-Trader.org

Paper-Trader is an online simulator built for serious paper traders who want to eliminate hindsight bias from their practice. As a paper trading website, we go beyond virtual money trading and mock trading — our random historical engine means you never know the market period in advance. Use it as an equity simulator for stocks, a forex demo, or a crypto backtester. Start your paper trading journey for free with our daily trial — no sign up required to begin. How to start paper trading? Just pick a market and click start — this is the best paper trading platform for zero-friction practice.

The Best Paper Trading Website & Free Online Simulator
